key_insight: RenalTransLSTM combines LSTM and Transformer layers to forecast ICU acute kidney injury earlier and more accurately across multiple time horizons.
clinical_relevance: The model could support earlier risk flagging and decision support in ICU settings by identifying patients likely to develop AKI before it occurs.
method: Trained on 48-hour EHR time-series histories from MIMIC-IV ICU admissions.
Predicted AKI at 6-, 12-, and 24-hour lead times.
Compared against SVM, XGBoost, LSTM, TG-LSTM, and a Transformer, with interpretability via Integrated Gradients and counterfactual analysis.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 61,735 MIMIC-IV admissions, the model achieved AUROC above 0.90 and F1 scores up to 0.85 across horizons, with ablation results favoring the hybrid design.
watch_item: Performance is promising but real-world deployment will need external validation, handling of irregular clinical data, and careful workflow integration to avoid alert fatigue.
paper_title: RenalTransLSTM: Multi-Horizon Prediction of Acute Kidney Injury in ICU Patients using a Hybrid LSTM-Transformer Architecture
